title: PortLeaseEnv
description: Environment contract emitted by every PortLease backend. Consumers read these keys and never a literal port.

AGENT_COORDINATOR_DB_PORT.description: Host port for PostgreSQL in the compose stack (block offset +0).

AGENT_COORDINATOR_REST_PORT.description: Host port for the coordinator REST API container (block offset +1).

AGENT_COORDINATOR_REALTIME_PORT.description: Host port for the realtime service (block offset +2).

API_PORT.description: Host port for the host-run coordination API started by the stack launcher (block offset +3).

UI_PORT.description: Host port for the kanban-viz dev server (block offset +4).

DB_PORT.description: Alias of AGENT_COORDINATOR_DB_PORT kept for the TestEnvironment protocol.

COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.description: Compose project name, ac- plus the first 8 hex chars of sha256(session_id).

portString.description: Decimal port 1024-65535 inclusive, as a string because it is an env var. The pattern enumerates the range rather than approximating it: the previous `^[1-9][0-9]{3,4}$` also accepted 1000-1023 (privileged) and 65536-99999 (unbindable), so a custom PORT_ALLOC_BASE outside the TCP range passed every backend's contract-validation test while emitting ports nothing could bind.

localhostUrl.description: http://localhost:<port>, with the same 1024-65535 bound as portString. Kept in sync with portString by contract test; a URL is not valid if its port could not be bound.
